findings.reason: A real report with string/list/integer command evidence previously escaped the typed recovery boundary through AttributeError. The repair request is now hashed immediately after the runtime writes it, rechecked before any edit/retry, and rechecked when receipt evidence is finalized. A red provider-time corruption case now refuses before source mutation or command replay.

Exact-head GitHub Actions run 42937213846 passed release smoke plus both Ubuntu and both macOS jobs, but both Windows jobs correctly refused acceptance/recovery reads with unsupported_platform. The four positive success/resume tests now use the repository capability guard; production fail-closed behavior is unchanged and the bilingual code-repair contract states the boundary.
